40386420.finding: Constructed an integrated molecular, histopathological and clinical atlas of IBD incorporating whole-exome sequencing, tissue RNA-seq, serum proteomics and deep-learning-based histology scoring across 1,002 patients.

41559659.finding: Applied WGCNA, single-cell RNA-seq, LASSO Cox regression, xCell cell-type enrichment, TIDE and oncoPredict to glutamine-related genes in TCGA-CRC and GSE17537 for prognosis prediction in colorectal cancer.

37263023.finding: Integrated transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics profiles via knowledge-based integration to compare developmental neurotoxicity mechanisms of PFBS and PFOS in zebrafish embryos.

38969985.finding: Introduced the MTBE-SP3 workflow, a unified single-sample protocol integrating EtOH/MTBE metabolomic extraction with autoSP3 proteomic sample preparation, applicable to FFPE tissue, fresh-frozen tissue, plasma, serum and cells.

33575609.finding: Presented gNOMO, a Snakemake-based bioinformatic pipeline for integrative analysis of up to three meta-omics levels (metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, metaproteomics) from non-model organisms, demonstrated on the cockroach Blattella germanica gut microbiome.

33060801.finding: Demonstrated a reproducible network-based workflow integrating time-resolved proteome, transcriptome and methylome measurements in iPSC-derived human 3D cardiac microtissues to model anthracycline cardiotoxicity drug responses.

31672980.finding: Designed and released a Digital Research Object (DRO) embedding data, documentation and an analytic pipeline for a multi-modal mouse systems genetics sleep-regulation dataset (genome, brain/liver transcriptome, plasma metabolome, sleep phenome), with reproducibility tested by an independent bioinformatician.

35046932.finding: Proposed a novel pipeline integrating RNA-seq, ATAC-seq and ChIP-seq data with reduced-Cox regression to identify transcription factors regulating immune-related targets, exemplified by GATA4 binding at the GPRC5B promoter in colon adenocarcinoma.
35046932.model: human (colon adenocarcinoma cell lines and patient samples)

39537649.finding: The authors developed an integration pipeline combining multi-omics data with clinical and laboratory values to enable machine-learning-based classification of autoimmune diseases, achieving up to 96% prediction accuracy.

36760650.finding: A web/mobile variety test platform (VTP) was built to manage multi-location, multi-year crop variety testing workflows and phenotype data standardization, not for omics integration.

37191795.finding: The chapter describes Omics Notebook, an open-source reproducible framework for automated exploratory analysis, reporting and integration of mass spectrometry-based proteomic and metabolomic data.

34036326.finding: A generic, reproducible, open-access R-package data harmonisation framework is presented for parallel multi-omics integration and applied to COVID-19 drug-target discovery.

38412834.finding: Decomprolute is introduced as a Common Workflow Language, containerized benchmarking platform for comparing tumor deconvolution algorithms across matched transcriptomic and proteomic CPTAC datasets.

37961197.finding: SPEEDI is described as a fully automated end-to-end framework with data-driven batch inference for preprocessing, integration, and cell-type labeling in single-cell multi-omics, available as a web application.

37779245.finding: ScSmOP is presented as a universal, C-language computational pipeline for barcode identification, mapping and deconvolution of single-cell single-molecule multi-omics data (scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, scSPRITE, spatial).

41917819.finding: Lipidomic and proteomic profiling of a COVID-19 biobank cohort was used to stratify acutely infected versus convalescent patients and compare severity scores.

34429148.finding: A combinatorial multi-omics data analysis pipeline integrating ATAC-seq, RNA-seq, WGBS, Hi-C, Cut&Run, proteomics and phosphoproteomics was established to identify CTCF co-regulatory partners.

39366377.finding: The peer-reviewed publication of SPEEDI presents it as an automated end-to-end single-cell multi-omics framework with data-driven batch inference, parameter-free execution and an interactive web application.

37879938.finding: MICA is a non-linear mutual-information-based method, benchmarked against alternatives, that integrates single-cell transcriptome with chromatin accessibility to infer gene regulatory networks in early human embryos.

35662721.finding: An integrative framework (ProLnc) was applied to multi-cohort hepatocellular carcinoma data to identify proliferation-derived lncRNA signatures for risk stratification, rather than serving as a general multi-omics software tool.

41034612.finding: Giotto Suite is a suite of modular R packages providing scalable, technology-agnostic end-to-end solutions for multiscale spatial multiomic data analysis, integration and visualization built around an innovative spatial data framework.
41034612.model: spatial multiomics (molecular, morphology, spatial, annotated features)

40681987.finding: SCNT is an R package that wraps Seurat/ggplot2 for QC, dimensionality reduction, doublet detection and high-resolution visualization of single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, with stated future plans for multi-omics integration.

38452346.finding: Shu is a Python/web visualization tool that integrates diverse data types (including multi-omics) onto metabolic maps using a Grammar-of-Graphics API for easy pipeline integration.

35047813.finding: InterTADs is a framework for integrating same-sample multi-omics data within topologically associating domains, with downstream statistical, enrichment (KEGG/GO/TFBS) and visualization analyses, demonstrated on chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

37673036.finding: A 4-month NAFLD randomized trial couples metagenomics and metabolomics with multi-omics integrative analyses, fecal microbiota transplantation and monocolonization to link resistant starch, Bacteroides stercoris, BCAAs and hepatic steatosis.
37673036.model: human gut microbiome + serum metabolome (NAFLD patients, mice)

29173869.finding: A perspective/review arguing that functional contributions of the human gut microbiome require molecular high-throughput measurements, experimental models and integrative multi-omics approaches.

40213833.finding: A review summarizing how gut microbiota and microbial metabolites interface with host DNA methylation, histone methylation, lactylation, glycosylation and non-coding RNAs in IBD, highlighting multi-omics for dissecting host-microbe interactions.

35953094.finding: Integrated metagenomic and metabolomic analyses in 266 CRC subjects identify distinct microbiome-metabolome signatures (e.g., F. nucleatum/GABA in late-onset; F. plauti/tryptophan-bile acid-choline in early-onset) and build multi-omics classifiers for EO-CRC.

31171880.finding: Large-cohort (n=616) fecal metagenomic and metabolomic study identifies stage-specific microbial (F. nucleatum, A. parvulum, A. odontolyticus) and metabolic (BCAAs, phenylalanine, bile acids) shifts across colorectal adenoma-carcinoma progression.

32152478.finding: A review of human NAFLD gut microbiome signatures discussing confounding by obesity/T2D, methodological heterogeneity and the need for multi-omics systems-biology approaches to derive robust microbiome biomarkers.

31142858.finding: Longitudinal profiling of transcriptomes, metabolomes, cytokines, proteomes and the microbiome in 106 prediabetic/healthy individuals reveals host-microbe co-associations and early molecular signatures preceding T2D onset.

38042287.finding: Machine learning (logistic regression, SVM, Gaussian naive Bayes, random forest) applied to gut microbiome, serum metabolome and lipidome data identifies metabolite-based classifiers (3-hydroxybutyric acid, 9-oxo-ode) for type 1 diabetes.
38042287.model: gut microbiome + serum metabolome + lipidome (human T1D)

32076369.finding: This review collects and summarizes tools and methods that adopt integrative approaches to analyze multiple omics data, including their methodology, use-cases, and limitations for applications such as disease subtyping and biomarker prediction.

31114869.finding: MEXPRESS is an online tool that integrates and visualizes gene expression, DNA methylation, and clinical data from TCGA, uniquely depicting expression and methylation together with precise genomic methylation location.

41251150.finding: Reactome is a curated pathway knowledgebase whose new analysis tools support multi-omics integration and customizable visualizations.

40934376.finding: The paper presents a new approach using deep learning on subsampled nonlinear dimensionality reduction (t-SNE/UMAP) to extract features and integrate large multi-omics datasets including mass spectrometry imaging.

41054136.finding: A bibliometric and visualization analysis of 1148 omics articles on osteoporosis using CiteSpace, VOSviewer, and R, describing the historical evolution of the field rather than any software tool.

42665670.finding: An integrative multi-omics analysis of non-histone acetylation substrate-related transcriptional landscapes in colon adenocarcinoma that uses deep learning-based pathomics but is an application rather than a software description.

39522934.finding: A bibliometric analysis of nutrition and radiotherapy research using VOSviewer, Bibliometrix, and Citespace that does not describe or compare multi-omics integration software.

40106419.finding: HemAtlas is a multi-omics platform that systematically integrates functional genomics datasets from humans, mice, zebrafish, and HSPC in vitro culture systems with cross-stage, cross-species, and cross-model analyses.

40948029.finding: ggalign is an R package extending ggplot2 with composable, data-aware layouts and a linking mechanism for visualizing interconnections across heterogeneous data types in genomic and microbiome studies.

38664601.finding: OMIC is a method for orthogonal multimodality integration and clustering of CITE-seq data that accounts for dependence among modalities and outperforms existing methods in accuracy and efficiency.

40355757.finding: A comprehensive SLC knowledgebase integrates systematic multi-omics datasets with curated information and is exposed through a web portal with interactive dashboards and visualization tools for human solute carrier analysis.

38163104.finding: The study introduces a method that uses PaCMAP to merge CNA, DNA methylation, and gene expression into a 2D colored map fed into a CNN, outperforming the i-SOM-GSN model for prostate cancer Gleason score prediction.

39604623.finding: An observational trial in 61 healthy adults used multi-omics over 9 days to profile gut microbiome composition and metabolism, linking variations to gut physiology and environmental factors such as transit time, pH, and stool moisture.

37165188.finding: An ingestible sampling device was used to collect 240 intestinal samples from 15 healthy individuals and multi-omics analyses revealed differences in bacteria, phages, host proteins and metabolites along the intestines versus stool.

37611587.finding: Multi-omics (microbiome and metabolome) studies in genetically controlled mouse cohorts identified diet-driven shifts in microbial and metabolomic profiles associated with colorectal cancer progression.

41950533.finding: A review examining how gut microbiota-centered multi-omics can be translated into decision support for treat-to-target IBD management, proposing a pragmatic tiered workflow combining minimal signatures with clinical markers.

41613079.finding: An integrative review synthesizes five omics layers (host miRNAs, host-pathogen genetic markers, microbiome, viromics, transcriptomics) into a predictive framework for zoonotic spillover detection.

41651877.finding: A review outlines a multi-omics-guided Assembly-Assessment-Redesign (A-A-R) workflow for designing defined microbial consortia for reproducible fermented food production.

27986083.finding: The IMP pipeline is a reproducible, modular, Docker-based workflow for reference-independent integrated analysis of coupled metagenomic and metatranscriptomic microbiome data, including co-assembly, binning, and signature-based visualizations.

36864178.finding: A review of single-cell and spatial multi-omics technologies highlights computational strategies and tools needed to integrate genome, epigenome, transcriptome, proteome, and/or metabolome data from single cells.

37280296.finding: A comprehensive review of single-cell multi-omics technologies discusses bioinformatics tools and mathematical/computational methods developed to link and integrate different omics modalities.

37119971.finding: A review highlights current and emerging multi-omics modalities for precision health, discussing their applications in genetic variation, cardio-metabolic diseases, cancer, infectious diseases and other clinical areas.

36596352.finding: The review outlines a roadmap of multi-omics integration analysis using artificial intelligence strategies for cancer precision medicine, including dimensionality reduction and multimodal data integration.

39182134.finding: A review of spatial multi-omics examines the evolution of multi-omics technologies and computational methods for modality integration, including improvements in throughput, resolution, and accuracy.

38837434.finding: This review synthesizes insights from genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, epigenomics and lipidomics to unravel atopic dermatitis pathogenesis, projecting future trajectories of multi-omics integration for personalized medicine.

38286161.finding: This review summarizes current research on using multi-omics technologies (genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics) combined with AI methodologies to predict neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy response in esophageal cancer.

41591802.finding: This review highlights AI-based habitat imaging analysis (Radiomics++) workflow and methodology for decoding intratumor heterogeneity, and anticipates integration of AI-defined habitats with multi-omics for precision medicine.

41882401.finding: This chapter outlines key features, experimental and bioinformatic workflows, and commonly used computational tools for genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics and meta-omics approaches in microbial ecosystems, including integrative multi-omics strategies.

38184138.finding: This review examines the roles of biomolecules and functional pathways across genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and metabolomics in myocarditis pathogenesis, underscoring the need for a multi-omics approach.

41922965.finding: This systematic review synthesizes applications of machine learning methods (random forest, XGBoost, autoencoders, stacking ensembles, CNN-LSTM) for multi-omics data integration in crop improvement across 76 eligible studies.

41453552.finding: This review synthesizes multi-omics evidence (single-cell transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, spatial profiling) to define immunometabolic phenotypes and resistance mechanisms in the lung cancer tumor-immune interface.

40565540.finding: This review provides a detailed overview of deep learning model architectures, datasets and innovations applied to multi-omics data for cancer type classification, driver gene identification, survival analysis and drug response prediction.
